posts.name: Hub
posts.tagline: Run 100 Claude Code or Codex sessions like 5
posts.description: Open-source dispatcher for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Write a goal in your browser or Telegram, a coordinator hands it to agents, and only the decisions come back. Self-hosted, Apache-2.0, on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription. One-line install. Experimental: agents run without permission prompts.

posts.name: QA.tech MCP
posts.tagline: Verify every change from your IDE with QA agents
posts.description: QA.tech MCP gives Claude Code, Cursor or Codex an external QA agent to check their work. It runs E2E tests on what each change does to your product and finds the bugs and edge cases your coding agent missed, so they get fixed before the PR goes to review. Stay in your IDE: QA.tech explores your app, writes the tests and runs them. Your coding agent reads the results and fixes what broke. Works with any MCP client. New to QA.tech? One prompt maps your app and kicks off your first test.

posts.name: ExtraOrbital
posts.tagline: ✦ Open bar databases, storage buckets & AI keys for agents
posts.description: Your app needs databases, storage, caching, AI keys, and more. That's dozens of accounts, API keys, invoices, and backups to manage. Agents can't stand it. They don't even have access. You feel like their credentials go-fetch puppet. ExtraOrbital reads yourenv.example file and creates all these ressources for you. It's a CLI, so your agents can use it. They don't even need an account. You gain back control, increase security and manage everything in a central dashboard. Bye bye,env hell !

posts.name: Bifura
posts.tagline: See your website the way AI agents do
posts.description: AI assistants now read websites for your buyers. Bifura fetches your page the way AI crawlers do, shows what they get and get wrong, and lets you test fixes in a sandbox before you ship. Free Agent readiness score in under a minute, no signup.

posts.name: Pax by Pydantic
posts.tagline: A coding agent where even coding is a plugin
posts.description: Pax is the official Pydantic AI coding agent for your terminal. Every part is a plugin, it runs any model, and --agent runs your own Pydantic AI agent in it.

posts.name: Doodle
posts.tagline: The stick figure on your taskbar that answers questions
posts.description: Doodle is a little AI companion that lives on your Windows taskbar. Ask it anything with Ctrl+Shift+Space, or dictate into any app. When it can't do something, Doodle Evolution builds a bespoke plugin, shows you what it can reach, and waits for your OK.

posts.name: Clary
posts.tagline: iOS notifications in sender's own voice from WhatsApp & more
posts.description: Clary reads your iPhone notifications in the sender's own voice, from WhatsApp, iMessage and more. It uses voice cloning: each person records 20 seconds once, from a link, and agrees first, then Clary makes their voice on your iPhone. Tap a message to hear it in their voice, so you feel closer to your people. It also keeps your notifications as a history on your iPhone, sorted Gmail-style into Messages, Updates and Promotions. Free: history, sorting and 2 plays. Needs iPhone 15 Pro+ and iOS 27.

posts.name: Kagi Mail
posts.tagline: Private email that puts people who need you first
posts.description: Kagi Mail is a private email service designed to help you focus on what matters. Its intelligent inbox highlights people waiting for your reply, identifies emails that need action, and keeps newsletters and unwanted messages out of the way. Ask questions about your inbox, organize emails using natural-language rules, and use unlimited aliases and custom domains. No ads, no tracking, no profiling. Includes 50 GB storage and a built-in calendar, with open standards and no vendor lock-in.

posts.name: DeskFleet
posts.tagline: Run coding agents together across your team’s machines
posts.description: DeskFleet gives your team a shared session with the coding agents you already use. Run Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor where your code lives. A teammate can join from their laptop, review the diff, approve the next command, or take control of the remote desktop. Your tools and agent credentials stay on the machine doing the work.

posts.name: Monton
posts.tagline: AI agents that do your agency's busywork
posts.description: Monton is agency management software with AI agents built in. Agents watch budgets, chase overdue invoices, write client reports and remind people about missing hours, on your real hours, staffing, billing and CRM data. Pick one of 18 templates or describe it in a chat. Every email waits for your approval. AI is included in every paid plan: no credits, no per-seat pricing. Free up to 5 people.

posts.name: Flurra
posts.tagline: Ask Claude or ChatGPT to edit your videos
posts.description: Flurra is a video editor that Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants can use for you. Connect it once (sign in, no API key), then describe the edit: cut the dead air, add bold hook text, put your logo top-right, cut yourself onto a new background, or match the style of a video you love. Claude edits your Flurra project, you preview every change and keep only what you like, then it renders the 1080p cut. Flurra also writes scripts in your voice and plans your posts. iPhone and web.

posts.name: Remora
posts.tagline: The long-term memory layer for AI agents
posts.description: Remora is continuous memory infrastructure for AI agents. Ingest conversations, deduplicate facts, and recall relevant context in under 15ms. Powered by PostgreSQL + pgvector with native Python & TypeScript SDKs. Stop re-inventing memory tables.

posts.name: Transept AI
posts.tagline: Translate your book in your own voice and prove authorship
posts.description: Since our first launch, Transept became a tool for writers translating their own books. New: you read the translation as a book, next to your original. Author mode reads your manuscript first and drafts the glossary, style guide and characters for you to approve. The Originality report records, word by word, what the AI wrote and what you changed. PDFs come back as the same pages. The Free plan translates your first page in full; paid plans from €9/$10 a month.

posts.name: Watch Reader
posts.tagline: Books and articles, read aloud on your Apple Watch
posts.description: Add books, articles and web pages on your iPhone, then leave it at home. The AI voice runs on your Apple Watch itself, so it reads to you with no signal. Morning news, 25 voices, free classics. Free to download, with 30min free listening everyday forever.

posts.name: Nookdeck
posts.tagline: Turn your old phone into a Stream Deck for your computer
posts.description: Nookdeck turns an old phone or tablet into a touch control panel for your Mac or Windows PC. A small app on the computer serves the panel to the phone's browser over Wi-Fi: no app to install on the phone, no account, no cloud. Old iPhones on iOS 12 work too. Buttons for shortcuts, apps, media and macros; live tiles for system stats, Now Playing and weather; Home Assistant controls; Claude and Codex usage; plugins and theme packs. Free and open source (MIT).

posts.name: iwantmy.app
posts.tagline: Describe a mobile app in chat and open it on your phone
posts.description: Tell iwantmy.app what your app is for and who uses it. About a minute later it runs on a phone, with accounts, staff roles, bookings with places left, photos, maps and group chat built in. Ask for changes in chat; each one goes live when it is done, and a failed change leaves the app as it was. Open your app from its link or QR code in the phone's browser, or in our test app for iPhone and Android. Free plan: 1 app and 30 AI changes a month, no card.

posts.name: Meboki
posts.tagline: Offline grammar checker for any Mac app. Open source
posts.description: Most grammar checkers send everything you type to someone else's server. Meboki checks your English with an open-source AI model running on your own Mac. Wavy underlines appear as you type in Mail, Slack, Notion, Gmail and most other apps; press Return to fix them all. Like Grammarly's grammar and spelling fixes, but offline: no account, no subscription, no telemetry. GPL-3.0 source. $39 once, 50% off each for 3+ licences; free hotkey mode after the 7-day trial. Apple Silicon, macOS 14+.

posts.name: Ground
posts.tagline: Generate high quality synthetic data for testing or training
posts.description: Ground turns a one-sentence description into consistent synthetic tables where every key, total and rate holds, or extends a dataset you already have. One sentence produced 72,365 rows with 0 orphan keys; asked for ~5% overdue, it delivered. Use it in the browser, via API, or from Claude, Claude Code and ChatGPT through its MCP server. If you need human written level data at scale Ground has you covered.

posts.name: Superframes
posts.tagline: Brief an AI Director to edit the whole video
posts.description: Superframes is an AI video editor with a Director inside. Give it a brief and it plans the edit, cuts it on a real timeline and lists each change, so you can undo one or all of them. It turns one long video into a board of captioned Shorts, and it generates the clip, voice or music you are missing. Editing runs on your device and your video files are never uploaded. Browser, Mac and Windows. Free to start, no account.

posts.name: Upsolve Harness 2.0
posts.tagline: A data agent that's 2x faster and learns every user
posts.description: We rebuilt our agent harness from scratch for people who don't know the data. Twice as fast, self-correcting SQL, custom skills for your analyses, suggestions that improve it over time, and memory that personalises every user.

posts.name: Mime
posts.tagline: Silent dictation: mouth the words and it types them
posts.description: Hold a key, mouth the words, let go. Mime types what you said, in any app, without a sound.

posts.name: OpenChat
posts.tagline: Open-source live chat in your own Cloudflare account
posts.description: Customer chat for your website that runs in your own Cloudflare account, so conversations stay with you. A 2 KB widget in 11 languages, a team inbox on web, iPhone and Android with end-to-end encrypted notifications, a help centre, and an optional AI assistant that answers first and hands over to a person. Open source and self-hosted, with one-click deploy.

posts.name: Hello Transcribe 5
posts.tagline: Private transcription with speaker labels, all on device
posts.description: Hello Transcribe turns speech into text on your iPhone, iPad and Mac, entirely on device: no account, no uploads. Free: Apple SpeechAnalyzer and every whisper.cpp model. PRO: Speaker labels with NVIDIA Nemotron, Parakeet v3 and Whisper on Core AI, iCloud Sync & Audio save.

posts.name: FocusHaze
posts.tagline: Dim every window except the one you're working in
posts.description: FocusHaze dims every window except the one you're using, so the rest of your screen fades away. Click-through haze, adjustable intensity and color, smooth fades, multi-monitor, Ctrl+Alt+H toggle. 14 languages. Open source, no telemetry, no network.

posts.name: MeetFolks
posts.tagline: AI Notetaker for In-Person Meetings
posts.description: MeetFolks turns in-person meetings into named transcripts, summaries, and action items. Everyone joins from their own phone or laptop, so each person is captured close up by their own mic. Each device recognises its owner's voice, so you know who said what without labelling speakers yourself or buying a dedicated recorder.

posts.name: MusicProductionAI
posts.tagline: Make music from a prompt or a hum, right in your browser
posts.description: Music production software that runs in a browser tab. Describe a track or upload a hummed melody and get an instrumental of 15, 30 or 60 seconds. Record, arrange and mix it in the built-in DAW, then export a WAV. Split any song into stems, find its chords and key, or program a beat on the free drum machine. Your first 3 tracks are free with no sign-up. After that it is pay as you go: one-time credit packs from $9, credits never expire, no subscription.

posts.name: Antipode
posts.tagline: Share your unused Claude Code limits without breaking ToS
posts.description: Your Claude Code weekly limit resets whether you used it or not. With Antipode, your agent spends what's left on a public GitHub project whose owner asked for help and opens a pull request. When you run out, others' agents work on yours. Free, open source.

posts.name: InfraThrone DevOps Park
posts.tagline: Fix 300+ real production outages in live DevOps labs
posts.description: Tutorials teach YAML. Production teaches panic. Today we're opening DevOps Park, so you can practise the panic part safely. War Zone: 300+ real outages rebuilt from AWS, Cloudflare and GitHub incidents, in a live terminal. Find the root cause, fix it, write the RCA. Roadmaps: DevOps, SRE and AIOps paths that end hands-on. Interview Bank: questions from 100+ companies, answered by experience level, each linked to an outage. Daily challenges, streaks and a leaderboard. Try it free.

posts.name: Postmaster of Puppets
posts.tagline: See if anyone can send email as your domain
posts.description: Type a domain and see whether anyone can send email as it, from its SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, with the DNS record that fixes most problems. Runs in your browser: no account, no cookies. Each rule cites its RFC or provider page. The engine is open source (MIT).

posts.name: Chunkify
posts.tagline: Video Streaming API for Developers & AI Agents
posts.description: Chunkify is a video streaming platform for developers and AI agents. Your videos stay in your own S3 or R2 bucket and stream through your CDN, so you always own your data. One API covers the full pipeline: uploads, per-title adaptive encoding, HLS streaming, thumbnails, captions and playback analytics.

posts.name: AgentDE
posts.tagline: Put all your coding agents in one native Mac window
posts.description: AgentDE puts all your terminal agents (Claude Code, Codex, or any other CLI agent) in one native Mac window. Each tab's icon shows its agent's state: green is working, amber needs you, blue is done. ⌘-click any path an agent prints and the file opens above the chat, at that line. Workstreams keep a shared record of each task that survives compaction. Tabs keep running when you quit or update. Free, MIT licensed, and built to be vibe coded into your own.

posts.name: WhipDesk
posts.tagline: Control AI coding agents from your phone
posts.description: WhipDesk puts your whole dev machine in your phone's browser, built for babysitting AI coding agents. Answer Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or Cursor when they get stuck, review the diff, and test what they built. Get alerts when an agent needs you, save one-tap prompts, and schedule a "resume" for when your session limit resets at 2 AM. Open source on both ends, end-to-end encrypted, free.

posts.name: ServNook
posts.tagline: XAMPP stopped at PHP 8.2. ServNook runs PHP 8.5 on Windows
posts.description: XAMPP's last release (Nov 2023) stops at PHP 8.2; PHP 8.5 is out. ServNook is a free, open-source (MIT) stack for Windows: Apache, PHP 8.5, MariaDB, phpMyAdmin, Node.js, Composer. Sites at name.localhost, several PHP versions, auto DB backups, XAMPP import.

posts.name: Ottante
posts.tagline: Checks the work your AI agents did, right on your Mac
posts.description: Your AI says it's done, but is it right? When Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini finish, Ottante compares the project with the model it came from and alerts you only about what's new. The check uses no AI. Stays on your Mac.

posts.name: SuperLoupe
posts.tagline: search inside anything on your Mac
posts.description: SuperLoupe searches inside every file, note, message and email on your Mac and preview every file without opening it.

posts.name: Claude-Mem Cloud Sync
posts.tagline: Switch devices. Keep your AI agents' memory.
posts.description: Claude-Mem is the open-source memory engine for AI coding agents (119k+ GitHub stars). Cloud Sync carries what your agents learn (decisions, fixes, discoveries) to every computer you use. Save a decision on your desktop, recall it from your laptop. See synced work in any browser, recall it in ChatGPT via a private MCP connector, and keep your own model provider. 30 days free, no card.

posts.name: NEXUS
posts.tagline: Map codebase locally and AI changes only what you approved
posts.description: NEXUS is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that helps you understand a codebase before anything changes it. It indexes a folder locally and maps the architecture — modules, imports, dependency cycles, most-imported files — with no AI or account. Share a one-file report with no source code, benchmark local models on your own hardware, and let AI agents work in a separate Git worktree that changes your files only after you approve the plan, each command and the diff.

posts.name: Fairwind
posts.tagline: Let a teacher or coach confirm your activities list
posts.description: For college applicants 14 and up. List activities, honors and research, send a link to the teacher or coach who was there, and they tick what they saw. One page shows who confirmed each entry. Confirming is always free. No AI, no rankings.

posts.name: Spiderlook
posts.tagline: Turn your rivals' ads, posts and site changes into insights
posts.description: Spiderlook is an AI-powered competitive intelligence platform for marketing teams and agencies. It tracks your rivals' Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, Meta and Google ads, and websites, bringing everything together in one place. Unlike tools that simply dump a feed of posts, Spiderlook highlights meaningful changes and turns them into actionable insights, each backed by the exact ad, post or page behind it. MCP included, so you can ask Claude or ChatGPT about your competitors.

posts.name: Heavano
posts.tagline: AI Voice Agents & AI Receptionist for Business
posts.description: Enterprise voice AI platform for deploying intelligent AI phone agents. Automates customer support, sales, IVR routing, appointment scheduling, and collections with 312ms turn latency across 42 languages.

posts.name: FORGE-SEC "Exploitability Validation"
posts.tagline: Know which scanner findings to fix first
posts.description: Finding vulnerabilities is easy. Knowing which ones to fix takes evidence. FORGE-SEC helps security and engineering teams import scanner findings, track AI-assisted validation, and see which issues need a closer look. Review the evidence, prioritize fixes, and share the report with your team.

posts.name: CarbonVault EUDR
posts.tagline: Satellite deforestation & EUDR compliance verification SaaS
posts.description: UploadKML/.GeoJSON or draw farm polygons for instant EUDR deforestation risk reports via Global Forest Watch. Built by NovaStack Cloud Systems (novastack-cloud-systems.vercel.app). Open to B2B partners & pre-seed investors.

posts.name: opsandgo
posts.tagline: Managed AWS hosting for React, Next.js and Node.js apps
posts.description: We run your live React, Next.js or Node.js app in a new AWS account in your name. We deploy, back up, monitor and patch it for a fixed monthly fee from $490. You pay AWS directly, with no markup. Every deploy can roll back, and the production database gets a restore test every month. A portal shows app status, deploys, monthly AWS cost and secrets. No lock-in: if you leave, the account stays yours.

posts.name: PahadiGo
posts.tagline: Tour Packages, Mountain Cabs & Homestays
posts.description: Book verified Himalayan tour packages, mountain cab rentals for Spiti & Leh, cozy homestays in Kasol & Manali, and trekking across Himachal, Uttarakhand, Kashmir, Ladakh & Northeast India.

posts.name: DevBills
posts.tagline: No more surprise API bills
posts.description: DevBills pulls daily spend from OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, Azure, MongoDB Atlas and more into one quiet Mac app. Spike alerts, a month-end forecast and a budget. Your keys stay in macOS Keychain, with no account and no servers. Pay once.

posts.name: homely
posts.tagline: Sell your home, keep the commission.
posts.description: A commission-free property marketplace for South Africa. List your home free, talk to buyers directly and get guided from first photo to final offer, with calculators, home loans and vetted conveyancers in one place. Property made simple.

posts.name: Wentfar
posts.tagline: Track, map, document & share your travels
posts.description: Wentfar makes it easy to track your travels, document adventures, and create a beautiful map of everywhere you've been: 🌍 travel map of your journey 🌍 save places, memories, photos, and experiences 🌍 share your travels with close ones 🌍 use travel tools like packing lists, currency converter, cost tracker, etc 🌍 discover your travel history & see how far you've gone Wentfar helps you capture every journey and make your travels last beyond the trip. Get Wentfar!

posts.name: Nedzo
posts.tagline: AI voice agents for every client your agency runs
posts.description: Nedzo gives agencies one login for every client. Each client gets a workspace with its own AI agent, phone numbers, contacts and knowledge. Agents handle calls, SMS and email, book into Google Calendar, Calendly and Cal.com, and warm-transfer to the client's team. 39 languages and about 600 voices. HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR. White-label on VIP. Sign up from Product Hunt and get a 30-day trial with 100 free minutes.

posts.name: Mouse Scroll
posts.tagline: Smooth scrolling for any mouse on Mac
posts.description: Mouse Scroll makes your Mac’s mouse wheel feel as smooth as a trackpad. Choose a preset or fine-tune the motion, set scrolling direction separately from your trackpad, and customize settings for each app. Hold a modifier key for precise, faster, or horizontal scrolling. Built-in compatibility rules handle apps that need native scrolling. Free essentials, with a one-time Pro upgrade. No subscription, account, or data collection.

posts.name: Make It Weird Cards
posts.tagline: Greeting cards with personality
posts.description: Wonderfully weird greeting cards, created in Make It Weird Studio. Discover original designs by Paula and our creative community.

posts.name: Vanryx
posts.tagline: Crypto Payment Gateway & Wallet for Business
posts.description: Accept crypto payments with Vanryx a fast, business-ready crypto payment gateway. Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT and more with powerful API, payment links and secure dashboard.

posts.name: Omi CEO
posts.tagline: Type an AI SaaS idea. Become a CEO in 10 minutes.
posts.description: Omi CEO builds your AI SaaS, markets it and helps it run on its own. Type an AI SaaS idea: Omi builds the live product, brand, pricing and checkout, and a launch kit. Then an AI crew (CEO, Builder, Marketer, Sales) works on it every day within the budget you set. You keep 100% of your sales. Free preview; CEO plan $49 first month, then $19/mo or $190/yr.

posts.name: VibeHit
posts.tagline: Your transformed voice into your in-game mic
posts.description: VibeHit puts music, soundboard and your transformed voice into your in-game mic. For GTA-RP and any game with voice chat. Free for Windows 10 and 11.

posts.name: Parible
posts.tagline: The software discovery platform for website teams.
posts.description: Compare over 500+ website marketing and development tools by pricing, features & more.

posts.name: Vouch
posts.tagline: Verify any website's claims with reviews from real visitors
posts.description: See whether a website does what it says, from people who were actually there. Shops, agencies, clinics, landlords and apps all make claims ("ships in 48 hours", "certified electricians", "cancel any time"), and the reviews on their own pages are the ones they chose. Vouch is a free Chrome extension (Safari coming soon) that puts a verdict in the corner of any site. A review only counts if the extension saw you on the site in the last 30 days, and Vouch takes no money from the sites it rates.

posts.name: Friendship Drift
posts.tagline: See which friendships are drifting and who to message first
posts.description: Nobody fights. The texts just slow down, then stop. Friendship Drift is a free 2-minute check: add up to 5 friends, see who's drifting and who to message first, then send a hello in one tap. No sign-up, nothing saved. Made by the creator of Reach Out.

posts.name: What2Munch
posts.tagline: One tap picks a real restaurant from Wolt for you
posts.description: Pick a nearby Wolt restaurant or let your friends choose with a group vote.

posts.name: StackFocus
posts.tagline: Macro focus stacking, entirely on your phone
posts.description: StackFocus turns your iPhone or Android phone into a dedicated macro focus-stacking camera. One tap sweeps the lens through your subject and captures up to 28 frames; every frame is aligned against handheld drift and parallax, and the sharpest pixels are blended into one tack-sharp photo at full sensor resolution. Edit and export on the device. No cloud, no account, no subscription: free to try with three full-res exports, then a one-time $4.99.

posts.name: Stairtop
posts.tagline: Predict days to sell and track active listings for agents
posts.description: Stairtop is pricing and active-listing software for residential real estate agents across 84 counties in California and Utah (7 live MLS feeds). Drag any asking price to show sellers predicted days to pending (within ~6 days on average), comps, and net proceeds. Once listed, sync active MLS listings in about a minute. Stairtop checks each home daily against nearby comps, competing price cuts, and open houses, telling you when to hold price or adjust and by how much.

posts.name: Smart Tab Organizer
posts.tagline: Auto-group Chrome tabs, save workspaces & sleep idle tabs
posts.description: Organize tabs into color-coded groups, auto-group as you browse, sleep idle tabs to save RAM, and save workspaces.

posts.name: Smart Tab Organizer
posts.tagline: Auto-group Chrome tabs, save workspaces & sleep idle tabs
posts.description: Organize tabs into color-coded groups, auto-group as you browse, sleep idle tabs to save RAM, and save workspaces.

posts.name: TokensOn.Sale
posts.tagline: Find cheap tokens and free inference.
posts.description: TokensOn.Sale is a deal feed for cheap AI tokens and inference. 💸 It lists free tiers, credits, plan discounts and price cuts from AI vendors. An agent checks for new deals many times a day.

posts.name: Presto
posts.tagline: Hold a key, talk, and it's typed. On your Mac, in any app
posts.description: Push-to-talk dictation for Mac. Hold Fn, talk, let go, and the text lands wherever you're typing. Fast, and the speech model runs on your Mac. English and Czech picked automatically. Learns your names and words on its own. No monthly subscription.

posts.name: Melody Craft
posts.tagline: Offline audio-to-MIDI transcription with A/B playback
posts.description: Melody Craft transcribes vocals, bass, guitar, and piano recordings into editable MIDI with preserved pitch bends completely offline on Windows and Linux. Compare the original recording against transcribed MIDI with level-matched A/B playback, inspect individual notes on the piano roll, and export DAW-ready MIDI with no cloud upload or subscription.

posts.name: OnToGraPh
posts.tagline: Agent-ready ontology with rules you can test in each app
posts.description: Build an ontology with domain experts, review the rules in Studio, and test what each app does after release and withdrawal. Run locally with Python and SQLite. Watch the Aurora 21 case: https://openontograph.org/launch/

posts.name: Nitidea: Old Photo Restoration, Offline
posts.tagline: Restore old photos, remove grain, upscale — nothing uploaded
posts.description: Drop in your photos, choose Sharper, Bigger or Old photo, press Enhance. Nitidea removes grain, enlarges 2× or 4× (sized for print at 300 dpi if you like), and repairs old photos: scratches and dust filled in, black and white coloured. Pro enhances videos up to 4K too. Everything runs on your Windows PC, on the graphics card if you have one: nothing is uploaded, no account. Free forever with no watermark; Pro is €19 + VAT once, no subscription.

posts.name: Yearbib
posts.tagline: Your Strava Year in Sport, free, from your own export
posts.description: Strava put its annual recap behind an $80 subscription. Yearbib reads the data export every athlete can download for free and turns it into seven story cards, right in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, and it's open source.

posts.name: StudentCenter
posts.tagline: Create courses with AI, sell them, certify your learners
posts.description: Turn a topic or your PDF into an interactive lesson with AI, sell it to your learners at your price, and issue credentials they own that any employer can verify in one click. Black Friday: 30 days free on Pro or Enterprise.

posts.name: Custom Pet Portraits
posts.tagline: The perfect gift for pet lovers 🎁
posts.description: Turn their best friend into a museum-worthy framed portrait they'll treasure forever. Preview it free, then choose a 4K download, framed print or gallery canvas in four signature styles. Shipped free, in time for the holidays.

posts.name: Compress Locally
posts.tagline: Compress, convert, and resize images. Nothing is uploaded.
posts.description: Compress Locally is a free image toolkit that runs in your browser. Shrink a photo to the size an inbox or a form actually allows, convert JPG, PNG, and WebP, and resize or crop for a post, a listing, or a document. Drop up to 50 files and download one ZIP. No account and no install. Processing stays on your device — nothing is uploaded.

posts.name: Cutroom
posts.tagline: Podcast video that cuts itself, from a single camera
posts.description: Auto-editors assume a mic and a camera for every guest. Cutroom works from what most shows have: one camera and one mixed track. Drop in a recording of two to four people. It writes the transcript, matches each voice to a face by lip movement, and cuts in close on whoever's talking. Every cut stays yours to change. Export a full-resolution MP4 with optional captions, a subtitle file and an MP3. Runs on your Mac or PC: nothing uploaded, no account. Free and open source.

posts.name: Music24
posts.tagline: Get your song heard and grow the fans who stay
posts.description: Music24 turns one song into a whole release campaign for independent artists, managers and labels. Add your song and it makes the music video and cover art, posts to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube for you, finds the playlists that already play songs like yours, and shows what your music earns. No label or distributor needed. Start free.

posts.name: LearnXops Debug Coach
posts.tagline: Find and fix Kubernetes and Linux issues with an AI coach
posts.description: Connect your own Kubernetes cluster or Linux server in the LearnXops desktop app. You get a snapshot and what stands out, then your own AI agent traces each problem to its root cause, quoting the evidence. Pick Coach me to fix it yourself step by step, with Check my work after each step, or Fix it for me: you see every change, its risk and how to undo it, and nothing runs until you approve. Then you get labs to practise what you learned. Beta, for Pro members.

posts.name: Thump Forge
posts.tagline: Offline 12-module desktop bass amp sim and VST3 plugin
posts.description: Offline desktop bass amp sim, 12-module effects rack, and Windows VST3 plugin for Windows and Linux. Shape Studio DI and Vintage SVT tones with parallel compression, 4-band EQ spectrum, demo riff audition, and 5-string tuner.

posts.name: Wink
posts.tagline: Brand tracking built for marketers.
posts.description: Wink is an affordable and always-on brand tracking platform that measures brand awareness and performance with consumers in your category each month.

posts.name: GhostSweep
posts.tagline: Now finds shadow profiles, subscriptions and lost gift cards
